definitions.explanation: People who watch a performance, game, or event.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{観客|かんきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The audience gave a big round of applause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{観客|かんきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There were many spectators at today's game.

notes:
{観客|かんきゃく} refers to people who watch performances, sports, or events.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {観客|かんきゃく}⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (spectator seats, audience area)
- {観客|かんきゃく}⟦{動員|どういん}→動員：11927_douin⟧ (audience turnout)
- {観客|かんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かせる→沸く：01122_waku⟧ (to excite the audience)

COUNTER: ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ or ⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}→聴衆：13907_choushuu⟧: audience (for lectures, speeches)
- ⟦{視聴者|しちょうしゃ}→視聴者：02570_shichousha⟧: viewer (TV, online)
- {観客|かんきゃく}: audience (live events, sports)
- ⟦{観衆|かんしゅう}→観衆：22893_kanshuu⟧: spectators (more literary)

USAGE:
- Used for live performances, sports events, theater
- Not typically used for TV viewers (use ⟦{視聴者|しちょうしゃ}→視聴者：02570_shichousha⟧)
